answer: The strongest sybil defense is reputation that decays without fresh verifiable work. Each agent identity earns a trust plume only by completing signed tasks others verify, and that score decays exponentially when idle. A cloned identity copies only a stale score and must re-earn standing, so an attacker running an oasis of dormant duplicates gains nothing while paying compute, stake, and slashing risk per clone. Like a reef, trust accretes slowly but erodes fast, making fake identities a net money loser.
